title: Algeria administrative boundaries: national, 69 wilayas, 1,541 communes (OSM)
title_fr: Limites nationales et des wilayas de l'Algérie (69 wilayas, instantané OSM)
title_ar: حدود الجزائر الوطنية وحدود الولايات (69 ولاية، لقطة من OpenStreetMap)
description: Nested polygons for Algeria, its 69 wilayas and its 1,541 communes, built by AEO from an OpenStreetMap snapshot of 20 November 2026. Communes carry their ONS codes and French and Arabic names; wilayas are the union of their communes. The division follows Loi n° 26-06 of 4 April 2026 (JO n° 25): 69 wilayas and 1,541 communes; wilayas 59–69 were named by Décret présidentiel n° 26-206 (JO n° 40).
purpose: A versioned, openly licensed reference geography for summarising gridded data by wilaya, for the AEO map explorer, and for future wilaya-level search and downloads.
creator: Algeria Earth Observatory maintainers

processing: Commune boundary relations (admin_level 8 in Algeria, plus three commune relations tagged inconsistently in OSM: Birtouta 1634, Souk Oufella 0630, Dayet Ben Dahoua 4703) were downloaded from the Overpass API, assembled with shapely.polygonize and clipped to land with the OSM-derived geoBoundaries DZA ADM0 coastline mask. A Greek municipality carrying ref=4703 was excluded. Each commune was assigned to the 2026 wilaya covering most of its area (all communes ≥ 90 % inside one wilaya). Wilayas and the national outline are the union of their communes. Display versions were simplified with mapshaper (topology preserved).
validation: Automated checks at build (scripts/processing/build_admin.py): 1,541 communes with unique ONS codes; commune counts of wilayas 59–69 equal the lists in law 26-06 (Aflou 12, Barika 8, El Kantara 5, Bir El Ater 4, El Aricha 4, Ksar Chellala 6, Aïn Ouessara 10, Messaad 8, Ksar El Boukhari 21, Bou Saâda 23, El Abiodh Sidi Cheikh 7); each commune of wilayas 49–69 carries the ONS prefix of its mother wilaya; no commune overlaps above 0.01 km²; wilayas built from communes are identical to the OSM wilaya polygons (0 km² difference). Boundaries have not been checked against official survey data.
limitations: Community-mapped boundaries: not an official, legal or cadastral delineation. Positional accuracy varies.

Total polygon area is 2,309,832 km² (geodesic), about 3 % below the commonly cited official area of 2,381,741 km²; the difference comes from the OSM national outline and coastline, not from AEO processing, and is not adjusted.
commune_code is the ONS code; its first two digits are the wilaya of the 1984 organisation (wilaya_code_1984), not the 2026 wilaya (wilaya_code).
Transition period: under Loi n° 26-06 the mother wilayas hand over powers to the new wilayas by 31 December 2026; statistics published during the transition may still use 48 or 58 units.
Wilaya code 63 (El Aricha) has no ISO 3166-2 tag in OSM at snapshot time; the field is left empty rather than inferred.
Simplified display files are for web maps only; use the full-detail files for analysis.

algeria_notes: Algeria moved from 48 to 58 wilayas (Loi n° 19-12, 2019; names by Décret n° 21-117, 2021) and to 69 wilayas (Loi n° 26-06, 2026). Other open boundary sets checked by AEO (geoBoundaries, OCHA COD-AB, GADM) still show 48 wilayas. Check which configuration your statistics use before joining tables to polygons.

verification.notes: Processing log, fixes and legal checks in PROVENANCE.json of each version. Legal references verified in Journal Officiel PDFs (see research/wilaya_geography.md).
